title: CCM OPEN HF Registry
off: CCM Technologies OPEN HF Registry: Observational Patient EvaluatioN of CCM® Therapy for Heart Failure
summary: The registry has been designed to evaluate the long-term safety and efficacy of CCM therapy in a real-world setting.
desc: This is a global, prospective and retrospective, multicenter, single-arm, observational study intended to include patients who will receive/have received CCM therapy with an Impulse Dynamics system, including future CCM technologies (e.g. CCM-D), for a follow-up period of at least 5 years.
elig:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients who have /will be implanted with Impulse Dynamics CCM technologies (e.g. CCM or CCM-D when available) as determined by investigators
* Willing and able to provide informed consent, including for use of data for research purposes (e.g. publication, sub-studies/sub-analyses)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Noncompliant patients (e.g. for follow-up visits, medication, etc.) as determined by investigators.
* Subjects with a mechanical tricuspid valve

arms.d: Patients who will receive/ have received CCM therapy with an Impulse Dynamics devices
Patients who will receive CCM therapy with an Impulse Dynamics devices

primary.m: Assess CCM's effect on the rate and length of stay of heart failure (HF) hospitalizations
Demonstrate the long-term safety of CCM therapy in a real-world setting, by assessing the rate of device- or procedure-related complications.
